title: Anti-Counterfeiting and Online Enforcement
short: Customs recordals, marketplace and platform takedowns, domain disputes and criminal action against counterfeiters.
intro: Counterfeiting and online misuse are volume problems, and they need a programme rather than a series of one-off reactions. We design and run enforcement programmes that combine border measures, platform procedures, domain name recovery and, where warranted, criminal complaints and raids.

The aim is always commercial: reduce the volume of infringing goods and listings to a level the business can live with, at a cost that makes sense, and build the record that supports civil action against the serious offenders.
services: Recordation of trademarks with Indian Customs under the IPR (Imported Goods) Enforcement Rules and handling of detentions
Takedown programmes on e-commerce marketplaces, app stores and social media platforms
Domain name disputes under the INDRP and UDRP, and recovery of infringing domains
Investigations, test purchases and evidence preservation
Criminal complaints under Sections 103 and 104 of the Trade Marks Act and coordination of search and seizure
Civil actions against repeat infringers, importers and distributors
Brand protection guidelines and enforcement playbooks for in-house teams
Training of distributors, customs officers and enforcement agencies in identifying genuine goods

process.title: Mapping
process.text: Where the problem actually is: ports, platforms, physical markets or domains, and which rights can be used against it.

process.title: Programme design
process.text: A written enforcement plan with priorities, procedures and a budget, agreed with the business.

process.title: Execution
process.text: Recordals, takedowns, complaints and actions run on a schedule, with evidence preserved for later use.

process.title: Reporting
process.text: Periodic reports on volumes, outcomes and cost, so that the programme can be adjusted.
